description:
Once upon a time, there was a poor girl who spent all her time and energy helping her blind father. She was beautiful and kind, and she always wore a beautiful smile. Unfortunately, disaster struck her life. She decided to sacrifice herself to the Sea Lord in response to a promise. One cloudy day, she threw herself into the depths of the sea, praying to the god of the sea to save her father...

It seems like the tale should end here, and the girl would die. But suddenly, as in any fairytale, a miracle happens: our heroine wakes up in the arms of a handsome boy... From the future! Who is he? Is this a bad dream, or the finger of fate?! 

*Note: Based on the traditional Korean fairy tale **Sim Cheong Jeon** (심청전,The Tale of Sim Cheong).*
